Analysis of Push Notification Metrics for Bus Operators

The dataset contains a total of 14,985 events across 109 event types from November 27, 2025 to February 19, 2026. However, the push notification metrics indicate that there have been no notifications sent or delivered, resulting in a delivery rate and click rate of 0%.

Findings

  • DELIVERY PERFORMANCE: The delivery rate is 0%, which is significantly below the acceptable threshold of 60%. This indicates a complete failure in the push notification system, suggesting potential issues such as:
    • System notification failures.
    • Configuration issues preventing notifications from being sent.
    • Technical problems with the push notification service.
  • ENGAGEMENT DEPTH: With a click-to-delivered rate of 0%, there is no engagement data available. This lack of engagement implies that:
    • The notifications, if they had been sent, may not have been relevant or compelling to the recipients.
    • There is a need to reassess the content and targeting of notifications to improve relevance.
  • OPERATIONAL IMPACT: Given the absence of push notifications, there is no link to platform engagement activities such as Hisab or Dashboard interactions. This lack of activity suggests:
    • Potential missed opportunities for driving user engagement and operational efficiency.
    • The need for immediate investigation into the push notification system to restore functionality and engagement.

In conclusion, the current state of push notifications for bus operators is critically deficient, necessitating urgent attention to rectify the issues and enhance engagement strategies.
